channel.title: Pier & Point · 1470 Owens Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1470 Owens Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: A WRNS Studio page titled "UCSF Parking Structure" lists a 2012 completion, 10 stories and 627 stalls for what it calls the Owens Street Parking Structure, with no street number. Watry Design lists 1470 Owens as completed in 2020 with 4 levels and 317 stalls, so the WRNS page is treated as a different building; which building it depicts is not confirmed.
item.description: A WRNS Studio page titled "UCSF Parking Structure" lists a 2012 completion, 10 stories and 627 stalls for what it calls the Owens Street Parking Structure, with no street number. Watry Design lists 1470 Owens as completed in 2020 with 4 levels and 317 stalls, so the WRNS page is treated as a different building; which building it depicts is not confirmed. Source: https://wrnsstudio.com/projects/ucsf-parking-structure/ ; https://watrydesign.com/project/1470-owens-parking-structure ; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json.

item.title: Correction · 1470 Owens Street: The record now says the garage was designed by Watry Design and serves UCSF life-science buildings and Kaiser's medical offices. Before, it called it a UCSF parking structure designed by WRNS Studio, but Watry's own page names Watry as designer and lists the owner only as 'Developer'. The map use changed from institutional to commercial (the Assessor's class). The unsourced Kaiser address was dropped, the Assessor citation now points at the record for this parcel, the ERRCS administrative permit no longer carries a 'planned' status, permit descriptions no longer place every added security item on levels 2-4 (DBI places only the blue phones there), the $6,000,000 permit figure is described as the permit's unrevised valuation, and the aerial photo's caption and credit no longer say 'from a departing flight', which the Commons page does not state (the photographer's name is now cited to his Commons user page).
